source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 5, Theorem 7; pp. 5--6, Proposition 9; p. 8, Section 5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives an influence function and asymptotic normality for fixed HTC estimators and develops variance estimation and Wald inference.
Auxiliary cutsets are a recursive graphical identification construction; ACID subsumes listed auxiliary-variable and cutset criteria for individual direct effects.
The paper treats directed-tree models and uses missing bidirected cycles to produce and solve quadratic systems, including unique recovery after combining cycles.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct every HMS proposition locator to 7.2--7.4 and state the AC polynomial \(s^4+2s^3+s^2\) before specializing it to 36.

Make the Wald procedure total by defining a singular-\(\widehat V_F\) convention (for example, return \(\mathbb R^r\)) and an analogous denominator-pole convention for \(F_G(\widehat s)\); prove those exceptional events vanish uniformly on the chart.
Add one exact worked windmill instance that records formulas, all three criterion-failure transcripts, and the rank-obstruction matrix for every reachable predecessor set at a specified degree.

recommended_next_step: Revise the HMS citation locators and make the finite-sample rational/Wald output well-defined, then advance the field-tier frontier kernel to Stage 0.
